title: ggxy-ggZH-ampcache: reproduction package for gg → ZH at NLO+PS and LO+PS reweighting to NLO+PS
description: Reproduction package for loop-induced gg → ZH at 13 and 13.6 TeV, with Z → ℓ⁻ℓ⁺ and Z → νν̄ summed over three flavours. Includes pinned builds, the exact amplitude cache (merged upstream), Born suppression, fixed-order and POWHEG event generation, scale and PDF weights, parton showers, STXS analysis and theory-uncertainty comparisons. It also provides the LO+PS → NLO+PS reweighting: BDT-17 classifier ensembles for CMS-style (CP5, fixed scale) and ATLAS-style (A14, H_T scale) LO+PS sources in both decay channels, trained inside the domain pT(j1) < m_ZH, with calibration, independent evaluation and confirmation tests, NLO scale and PDF transport, and four deliverable model packages (ONNX models, calibration, application code and uncertainty recipe). production/paper.sh is the single definition of every run; analysis and data-release scripts reproduce and package the results.
